inheritance: all year-Y trades inherit beginning-of-year owner classification
non_partitionable: missing qualifying history in one or more lookback years; excluded
opportunistic: partitionable with no common calendar month across all three years
owner_identity: reporting-owner CIK only; name is non-key audit text
partitionable: at least one qualifying historical trade in each lookback year
routine: partitionable and at least one common calendar month across all three years

routine_history_transaction_universe.open_private_handling: P and S code universe is used for owner timing; ambiguity does not convert a row into H06 signal admission
routine_history_transaction_universe.rationale: CMP methodology classifies insiders from open-market trades in the same month in three prior years; signal direction is a separate taxonomy

trade_level_variant: not primary; only a later separately declared robustness variant
